description: Address Roslynator/CA diagnostics: CS1998 async without await in MakeAsyncCommand, CA1826 LINQ on indexable in MethodExtractor, CA1859 IReadOnlyList->List in MethodExtractor, CA1512 throw helper in MethodExtractor, CA1816 GC.SuppressFinalize in test Dispose methods.
ralph_instructions:
Fix the Roslynator diagnostics listed in each story. No RED phase — these are code quality fixes, not new features. Build and format must pass after each story.

BUILD COMMANDS:
  dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx
  dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal
  dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes

userStories.title: Fix CS1998, CA1826, CA1859, CA1512 in production code
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the production codebase free of Roslynator warnings so code quality is maintained.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all existing tests green

CS1998 fix — src/RoslynTools/Commands/MakeAsyncCommand.cs line 261: remove `async` keyword from `FindDocumentIdContainingMethodAsync`; change return type from `Task<DocumentId?>` to `DocumentId?`; update all call sites that await it to call it synchronously

CA1826 fix — src/RoslynTools/Core/MethodExtractor.cs: replace `bodyStatements.Last()` with `bodyStatements[^1]` (lines 224 and 231); replace `bodyStatements.First()` with `bodyStatements[0]` (line 238)

CA1859 fix — src/RoslynTools/Core/MethodExtractor.cs: change parameter type of `returnVars` in `BuildNewMethod` (line 205) and `BuildCallSite` (line 257) from `IReadOnlyList<ISymbol>` to `List<ISymbol>`. Update call sites to pass List directly (cast or change upstream variable type).

CA1512 fix — src/RoslynTools/Core/MethodExtractor.cs lines 23-25: replace explicit throws with `ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(startLine, 1)`, `ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(endLine, 1)`, `ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(startLine, endLine, nameof(startLine))`
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds with 0 warnings
dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
userStories.notes: For CS1998: FindDocumentIdContainingMethodAsync does not await — just returns DocumentId? directly. Remove async/Task wrapper and update the call sites to remove await. For CA1859: check what callers pass (likely already List<ISymbol> from DataFlowAnalysis results) — if not, change the upstream variable to List<ISymbol>.

userStories.title: Fix CA1816 GC.SuppressFinalize in test Dispose methods
userStories.description: As a developer, I want test Dispose methods to correctly call GC.SuppressFinalize so the CA1816 diagnostic is clean.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CA1816 fix — tests/RoslynTools.Tests/SolutionWriterTests.cs: in the Dispose() method, add `GC.SuppressFinalize(this);` as the last statement
CA1816 fix — tests/RoslynTools.Tests/SymbolFormatterTests.cs: in the Dispose() method (currently `=> _project.Dispose()`), expand to a block body and add `GC.SuppressFinalize(this);`
dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
userStories.notes: SymbolFormatterTests.Dispose is currently expression-bodied (`=> _project.Dispose()`). Expand to block body: `{ _project.Dispose(); GC.SuppressFinalize(this); }`. SolutionWriterTests.Dispose is already a block body — just add the SuppressFinalize call.
